title.en: pi-web-access: Install, Search Fallbacks, PDF & YouTube
title.zh: pi-web-access：安装、搜索降级、PDF 与 YouTube

description.en: Set up pi-web-access with source-verified search routing, PDF extraction, YouTube dependencies and practical verification steps.
description.zh: 安装 pi-web-access，了解经源码核验的搜索降级、PDF 提取、YouTube 依赖与实际验证步骤。

en: pi-web-access adds web_search, fetch_content and follow-up content retrieval to Pi. Use the installation command below, restart Pi, then begin with a public URL or a small search.
Zero setup applies to the keyless Exa MCP search path. It does not promise free access to every provider, offline operation, authenticated websites or YouTube analysis without an available backend.
zh: pi-web-access 为 Pi 添加 web_search、fetch_content 和后续内容读取工具。使用下方安装命令，重启 Pi 后，先读取公开网址或做一次小范围搜索。
零配置指免 Key 的 Exa MCP 搜索路径，不代表所有供应商都免费、可以离线使用，或无需后端即可读取登录网站和分析 YouTube。

en: Automatic search starts with configured SearXNG. When the active model is openai-codex it tries authenticated OpenAI first; otherwise Exa precedes OpenAI. Keyed Exa uses the direct API and unkeyed Exa uses MCP.

The remaining eligible sequence in this revision is Brave → Parallel → TinyFish → Search1API → Searchinfinity → Querit → Tavily → Firecrawl → Jina → SERPdive → Kagi → Bocha → Ollama → Perplexity → Gemini API/Web. Unavailable services are skipped. Cookie-based Gemini Web is opt-in.

DuckDuckGo is explicit-only. A named provider stays strict; searchRouting.providers can define an ordered route, and fallbackOn controls which failure types advance it. Do not assume every error silently selects another backend.
zh: 自动搜索先尝试已配置的 SearXNG。当前模型为 openai-codex 时，优先尝试已授权 OpenAI；否则 Exa 先于 OpenAI。有 Exa Key 使用直接 API，无 Key 使用 MCP。

此提交之后的可用来源顺序为 Brave → Parallel → TinyFish → Search1API → Searchinfinity → Querit → Tavily → Firecrawl → Jina → SERPdive → Kagi → Bocha → Ollama → Perplexity → Gemini API/Web。未配置的服务会跳过；依赖 Cookie 的 Gemini Web 需显式开启。
DuckDuckGo 需显式选择。指定单个 provider 时严格使用该来源；searchRouting.providers 可定义顺序，fallbackOn 决定哪些错误可以继续下一来源，不应假定所有错误都会自动降级。

title.zh: 网址提取的另一条路径

en: A GitHub repository can be cloned for local file access. Ordinary HTML first uses direct HTTP, Readability and an RSC parser. Configured self-hosted Firecrawl or Crawl4AI may follow; third-party hosted extractors require fetchRouting.allowRemoteHostedProviders: true for remote HTTP(S) targets.

That opt-in lets a remote service receive the target URL and perform its own fetch. It is separate from API search configuration. Neither the fallback chain nor “intelligent extraction” guarantees access to login-only, paywalled or anti-bot content.
zh: GitHub 仓库可克隆后本地读取。普通 HTML 先使用直接 HTTP、Readability 及 RSC 解析；之后可尝试配置好的自托管 Firecrawl 或 Crawl4AI。远程 HTTP(S) 目标若要用第三方托管提取器，需配置 fetchRouting.allowRemoteHostedProviders: true。
开启后，远程服务会收到目标网址并自行抓取；这与搜索 API 配置分别控制。降级链或“智能提取”都不保证读取登录页、付费墙或反爬页面。

title.zh: PDF 的依赖与数据路径

en: PDF extraction tries configured Datalab, then configured Gemini, then local unpdf/pdf.js. The local path does not need pdftotext, a browser or an API key, but reads only embedded text and has no OCR. Remote PDF tiers receive the PDF bytes.

Set pdf.provider to unpdf for local extraction; scanned pages may then return little or no text. Defaults are 20 MB and the first 100 pages. Remote errors can fall back locally, while cancellation and credential/configuration errors are not treated as ordinary recoverable failures.
zh: PDF 按已配置的 Datalab、已配置的 Gemini、最后本地 unpdf/pdf.js 的顺序提取。本地路径不需要 pdftotext、浏览器或 Key，但只能读取内嵌文字，没有 OCR；远程 PDF 路径会收到文件内容。
设置 pdf.provider 为 unpdf 可选择本地提取；扫描件可能读不到有效文字。默认限制 20 MB、前 100 页。远程普通错误可回退本地，但取消及凭据/配置错误不会被当作普通可恢复错误。

title.zh: 区分 YouTube 理解与抽帧

en: YouTube understanding tries Gemini Web when browser cookies are explicitly allowed, then Gemini API, then Perplexity. Configure an available authorized backend; private and age-restricted videos can fail across the chain.

ffmpeg and yt-dlp are optional system binaries for retrieving YouTube frames as images. They are not prerequisites for remote transcript/visual descriptions. Local video frame extraction needs ffmpeg; video analysis can upload the file to Gemini.
zh: YouTube 理解先尝试明确允许浏览器 Cookie 的 Gemini Web，再尝试 Gemini API、Perplexity。需要至少一个可用并已授权的后端；私密及年龄限制视频可能在整条链上失败。
ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp 是将 YouTube 帧提取为图片时的可选系统程序，并非远程转录/画面描述的前置条件。本地视频抽帧需要 ffmpeg；视频理解可能将文件上传到 Gemini。

en: Optional provider settings live in ~/.pi/agent/web-search.json. For example, braveApiKey can use "$BRAVE_API_KEY" to resolve that environment variable. Merge the PDF example above into the same JSON object when needed.

After restarting Pi, request a search and fetch as shown. Check source URLs and provider metadata, then try a known text PDF. These are reproducible verification steps, not a claim that this project ran each upstream service or measured extraction accuracy.
zh: 可选供应商配置位于 ~/.pi/agent/web-search.json。例如 braveApiKey 可写成 "$BRAVE_API_KEY"，从该环境变量解析凭据。需要时将上面的 PDF 设置合并到同一个 JSON 对象。
重启 Pi 后请求下面的搜索与抓取，检查来源链接及供应商元数据，再试一份已知的文本 PDF。这是可复现的验证方法，不代表本项目已调用所有上游服务或测量提取准确度。

sections.code:
web_search({ query: "Pi coding agent documentation", numResults: 3 })
fetch_content({ url: "https://pi.dev/" })

summary.en: Search, page extraction, PDF reading and video analysis through one extension.
summary.zh: 在同一扩展中搜索网页、提取正文、读取 PDF 和分析视频。

mechanism.en: Registers native Pi tools. Search routes to provider APIs or Exa MCP; ordinary URLs start with direct HTTP and local HTML extraction, with configured extraction fallbacks. GitHub repository URLs have a local clone path.
mechanism.zh: 注册 Pi 原生工具。搜索通过供应商 API 或 Exa MCP；普通网址先走直接 HTTP 与本地 HTML 提取，再按配置降级。GitHub 仓库网址另有本地克隆路径。

prerequisites.en: Pi and outbound network access. Exa MCP needs no API key; keyed providers need their own credentials. GitHub cloning needs Git. PDF text extraction uses bundled unpdf/pdf.js; ffmpeg and yt-dlp are optional for video frames.
prerequisites.zh: 需要 Pi 和可访问外网的网络。Exa MCP 免 Key，其他 API 需对应凭据。GitHub 克隆需要 Git；PDF 本地文字提取使用包内 unpdf/pdf.js；视频抽帧可选安装 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp。

limitations.en: Keyless does not mean offline or unlimited. DuckDuckGo is explicit-only. The local PDF fallback has no OCR. Private or age-restricted YouTube videos can fail, and readable content behind a paywall is not guaranteed.
limitations.zh: 免 Key 不代表离线或无限额度。DuckDuckGo 需显式选择；PDF 本地兜底没有 OCR；私密或年龄受限的 YouTube 视频可能失败，也不保证获取付费墙后的正文。

dataSent.en: Queries go to the chosen search service. Hosted extraction receives URLs; configured Datalab/Gemini PDF processing receives PDF bytes. Local video analysis may upload video to Gemini. Browser-cookie access is opt-in.
dataSent.zh: 查询发送给选中的搜索服务。托管提取服务接收网址；配置 Datalab/Gemini 的 PDF 处理会发送 PDF 文件内容；本地视频分析可能上传视频到 Gemini。浏览器 Cookie 读取需显式启用。

failure.en: Automatic search tries eligible fallbacks; a named provider is strict. Exhausted routes return diagnostics. Remote hosted HTTP extraction is disabled unless fetchRouting.allowRemoteHostedProviders is enabled.
failure.zh: 自动搜索尝试可用降级来源；指定供应商时严格使用该来源。来源耗尽返回诊断。远程托管 HTTP 提取须启用 fetchRouting.allowRemoteHostedProviders。
